title: A section of a separated morphism is a closed immersion
statement: Let $p:P\to E$ be a separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism], and let $s:E\to P$ be a section, so $p\circ s=\mathrm{id}_E$. Then $s$ is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion].
